visualCharacteristics.layout: flex-wrap row of feature cards; each card's width is author-set via a Width field (100/75/66/50/40/33/30/25%), so rows like 50/25/25 or 40/30/30 are possible
visualCharacteristics.imageTreatment: 16:9 cover — fixed aspect ratio so images crop-fill without distortion at any card width

contentPattern: Each card: category eyebrow, heading, image, a link, and a Card Width. Cards flow left-to-right and wrap; set widths so a row sums to ~100%.
usage: Editorial 'latest content / featured' promo rows on light backgrounds. Reusable across the site.
